document.abstract: With the introduction of a magazine-loaded projector using 8mm film in loop form the development of a self-contained daylight projection unit for use by teachers under classroom conditions to provide motion-picture illustrations in the course of their own lessons became a practical possibility. The development and demonstration of this idea in Great Britain and the production of the first films are described. This visual aid is now in production and more than 200 single-concept films are now available for teachers' use.
